primary_findings.quote: This analysis reveals that compared with placebo, vitamin D did not reduce any CVD events (RR = 0.95, 95%CI: 0.88-1.04), CVD mortality (RR = 1.04, 95%CI: 0.871-1.242), myocardial infarction event (RR = 0.96, 95%CI: 0.83-1.11), or myocardial infarction mortality (RR = 1.527, 95%CI: 0.828-2.816).
